# =============================================================================
# /frontend/.htaccess - VITE MULTI-ENTRY ROUTING FIX
# =============================================================================
# Problem Solved: router.php was redirecting ALL HTTP requests to enviar.php, 
# breaking the 5 independent HTML files (main/educacion/habilidades/contacto/servicios)
#
# Solution: Serve static file if exists, otherwise use PHP routing fallback
# Last Updated: 2026-05-12
# Generated By: fix-cpanel-routing issue resolution

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteBase /frontend/
  
  # CRITICAL FIX: Check if requested file/directory exists FIRST
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f [OR]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
  RewriteRule ^ - [L]  # Exists? Serve it directly. No PHP routing needed.

  # Fallback only for routes that DON'T exist as physical files (SPA mode)
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
  RewriteRule ^(.*)$ enviar.php?_fallback=${REQUEST_URI} [L,QSA]
</IfModule>

# API Routes - Backend endpoints go through router.php as before
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/(api/api/|backend/api) [NC,OR]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ enviar.php?route=api-request&path=$1 [L,QSA]

# Cloudflare + Security Headers
Header set X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
Header set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
